basic.name: Particle Grenade
basic.description:
Launch a particle grenade that deals 80~~0.04~~ damage to enemies within the area. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

Stores up to 4 charges.

basic.name: Personal Barrier
basic.description: Gain a Shield that absorbs 560~~0.04~~ damage for 3 seconds.

basic.name: Shield Ally
basic.description: Grants an allied Hero a Shield that absorbs 420~~0.04~~ damage for 3 seconds.

heroic.name: Graviton Surge
heroic.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30~~0.04~~ damage a second.

heroic.name: Expulsion Zone
heroic.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124~~0.04~~ damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

trait.name: Energy
trait.description: Each time Zarya's Personal Barrier or Shield Ally absorbs 9~~0.04~~ damage, her Energy is increased by 1. Each point of Energy increases Zarya's damage by 2%. After 0.5 seconds, Energy decays by 3 per second.

activable.name: Pain is Temporary
activable.description: Activate to consume all Energy and gain a Shield that absorbs 0.8% of Zarya's maximum Health per Energy consumed and lasts for 3 seconds. Zarya may only have one personal Shield active on herself at a time.

activable.name: Unyielding Defender
activable.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.

level1.name: Demolitions Expert
level1.description:
Quest: For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds.

Reward: Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.

level1.name: Together We Are Strong
level1.description: For 3 seconds after gaining Shield Ally, every 5.35~~0.04~~ damage done by the bearer contributes 1 Energy to Zarya, up to 40 Energy per Shield.

level1.name: Feel the Heat
level1.description: Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.

level1.name: Maximum Charge
level1.description:
Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy.

Quest: Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy.

Reward: Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.

level4.name: I Am the Strongest
level4.description:
Personal Barrier absorbs an additional 140~~0.04~~ damage. 

Passive: Damage absorbed by Zarya's Shields contributes 20% more Energy.

level4.name: Give Me Twenty
level4.description:
Quest: Regeneration Globes increase Shield Ally absorb amount by 15, up to 300 permanently. 

Reward: After collecting 20 Regen Globes, permanently reduce the cooldown of Shield Ally by 2 seconds.

level4.name: Speed Barrier
level4.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

level4.name: Defensive Shielding
level4.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier and Shield Ally grant 75 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks for 6 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

level7.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
level7.description: Particle Grenade deals 25~~0.04~~ more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

level7.name: Deep Burn
level7.description: Hitting a Hero with Particle Grenade causes Basic Attacks against them to generate 2 Energy. Lasts 4 seconds.

level7.name: Explosive Barrier
level7.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier explodes, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.

level10.name: Graviton Surge
level10.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30~~0.04~~ damage a second.

level10.name: Expulsion Zone
level10.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124~~0.04~~ damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

level13.name: Unstoppable Competitor
level13.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

level13.name: Spell Barrier
level13.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier grants Zarya 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken from Abilities by 75%.

level13.name: Endurance Training
level13.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya gains 20 Armor, reducing all damage taken by 20%.

level13.name: Pain is Temporary
level13.description: Activate to consume all Energy and gain a Shield that absorbs 0.8% of Zarya's maximum Health per Energy consumed and lasts for 3 seconds. Zarya may only have one personal Shield active on herself at a time.

level16.name: Cleansing Shield
level16.description: Causes Shield Ally to remove all disabling effects and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

level16.name: Gain Train
level16.description: Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.

level16.name: Born in Battle
level16.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya's cooldowns regenerate 25% faster.

level20.name: Gravity Kills
level20.description: Increases Graviton Surge's duration by 1 second and it Silences Heroes caught in its area.

level20.name: Clear Out
level20.description: Reduce Expulsion Zone's cooldown by 25 seconds and increase its duration by 1.5 seconds.

level20.name: Grenadier
level20.description: All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.

level20.name: Unyielding Defender
level20.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.
